results.title: Effectiveness of Topic-Based Chatbots on Mental Health Self-Care and Mental Well-Being: Randomized Controlled Trial [2024] Cited by 12 | Journal of Medical Internet Research
results.snippet: A rule-based, topic-specific chatbot intervention in improving self-care efficacy, mental health literacy, self-care intention, self-care behaviors, and mental well-being immediately after 10 days and 1 month of its use is evaluated.

results.title: Specialized tobacco quitline and basic needs navigation interventions to increase cessation among low income smokers: Study protocol for a randomized controlled trial. [2019] Cited by 23 | Contemporary Clinical Trials
results.snippet: The rationale, design and methods for a 2 × 2 randomized controlled trial currently underway comparing the effects of Standard and Specialized Tobacco Quitlines with and without Basic Needs Navigation on intervention engagement and smoking cessation among low-income smokers are detailed.

scores.reasoning: While all results are from high-quality peer-reviewed journals and many are RCTs, only result #9 directly addresses the socioeconomic achievement gap, making the set largely off-topic. The snippets provide moderate context but most results focus on unrelated interventions (insomnia, chatbots, tobacco cessation, cerebral palsy) rather than socioeconomic disparities in education.
